system.description: Starting at 6th level, your battle states are symbolized by materializing fragments of stone either being compressed and atomized while crashing, or by floating harmlessly around you while in flow. When you enter your Flow state, by spending 1 Tension, you manifest your Aegis. While your Aegis is manifested, when you take damage while within 10 feet of an Earthen Artifacts, you may choose to redirect up to half the damage you would take to that construct, as it takes the redirected damage in your place Any excess damage transferred back to you. While wearing your Aegis, once per turn, when you take damage, you reduce your AC by -1 (Max -2), until the beginning of your next turn.
